source_text: Critics counter that proxy consent has limits for irreversible, non-essential procedures: unlike vaccinations for imminent threats, circumcision's benefits are marginal in low-risk settings (e.g., preventing one urinary tract infection per 100–111 cases while risking two penile adhesions), and parents cannot override the child's future autonomy over intact tissue. [230]
